description:
What this is. When an employee moves to another company, farm or department, the move has to be recorded rather than typed over the top of their record — otherwise their history says they were always where they are now.

What to do. Record what is changing and from when. On submit their employee record is updated for you, and the transfer stays as the record of when it happened and why.

Where to find it. Employee Transfer, under HR.
name: Transfer an Employee
title: Employee Transfer — moving between units
